cmd:appearance.addEffect.label: Add Effect
cmd:appearance.addEffect.params: same as effect.apply (an alias): {effect: id, params?: {…}, item?: appearance item index|null, ids?, target?} → {ids, index, item}
cmd:appearance.addEffect.desc: Add an effect to the selected objects or to a fill or stroke in the Appearance panel.

cmd:appearance.addFill.label: Add New Fill
cmd:appearance.addFill.params: {ids?, target?: "object"|"contents"} add a fill on top of each selected object's own stack (a copy of its top fill; type without one: its characters' fill; else the default fill)
cmd:appearance.addFill.desc: Add a new fill on top of each selected object's existing fills from the Appearance panel.

cmd:appearance.addStroke.label: Add New Stroke
cmd:appearance.addStroke.params: {ids?, target?} add a stroke on top of each selected object's own stack (a copy of its top stroke, else the default stroke)
cmd:appearance.addStroke.desc: Add a new stroke on top of each selected object's existing strokes in the Appearance panel.

cmd:appearance.clear.label: Clear Appearance
cmd:appearance.clear.params: {ids?, target?} leave each object one empty fill and stroke (None; a group none of its own) and reset its opacity and blend mode
cmd:appearance.clear.desc: Leave each selected object one empty fill and stroke and reset its opacity and blend mode.

cmd:appearance.copyFrom.label: Eyedropper
cmd:appearance.copyFrom.params: {source: id, ids?, pickUp?, apply? (trees as eyedropper.setOptions, merged over the Eyedropper Options for this call), reverse?: bool, append?: bool} copy the attributes both picked up and applied (by default the whole appearance stack, opacity and blend mode, and from type to type the character and paragraph attributes) from `source` to ids (default: the selection), the fill, stroke and weight also to the paint defaults; `reverse` (Alt-click) copies from the first selected object (or ids) onto `source` instead; `append` (Shift+Alt-click) adds the source's fills, strokes and effects on top of each target's stack; placed gradients land at the same place relative to each target's bounds (defaults: fitted to new art) → {ids}
cmd:appearance.copyFrom.desc: Copy appearance attributes from one object to others, like using the eyedropper to pick up and apply styles.

cmd:appearance.duplicateItem.label: Duplicate Item
cmd:appearance.duplicateItem.params: {index | indices: [..] (paint-order item indices), to?: paint-order index of the copy (one `index` only; default: right above it, as Alt-dragging a row places it), ids?, target?} copy fills/strokes with their effects
cmd:appearance.duplicateItem.desc: Duplicate a fill or stroke row, with its effects, in the selected objects' appearance stacks.

cmd:appearance.moveItem.label: Reorder Appearance Item
cmd:appearance.moveItem.params: {from: paint-order item index | "contents", to, contents?: count, ids?, target?} move fill/stroke `from` to paint-order index `to`; on a group, layer or type the Contents (Characters) row stays between the same items (a moved item landing next to it keeps its side) unless `contents` says how many items paint below it afterwards. from "contents": move that row so `to` items paint below the members (characters) and the rest above → {index: where the item landed | contents: the row's slot}
cmd:appearance.moveItem.desc: Move a fill or stroke to another position in an object's paint order.

cmd:appearance.newArt.label: New Art Appearance
cmd:appearance.newArt.params: {} what the next object drawn gets → {basic: New Art Has Basic Appearance, appearance: {items, effects} (the model's JSON; placed gradients relative to the unit box), opacity: 0..100, blend, graphicStyle: the style it is linked to or null, inherited: taken from the last selection}
cmd:appearance.newArt.desc: Report the fill, stroke, effects, opacity and blend mode that new art will get.

cmd:appearance.reduceToBasic.label: Reduce to Basic Appearance
cmd:appearance.reduceToBasic.params: {ids?, target?} keep only the topmost visible fill and stroke, without their own opacity, blend mode or effects (a group keeps no rows it lacked), and drop the object's effects
cmd:appearance.reduceToBasic.desc: Reduce each selected object to one basic fill and stroke, dropping extra items, effects, opacity and blend mode.

cmd:appearance.removeItem.label: Remove Item
cmd:appearance.removeItem.params: {index | indices: [..] (paint-order item indices), ids?, target?} remove those fills/strokes from each target object's own stack
cmd:appearance.removeItem.desc: Remove chosen fills or strokes from the selected objects' appearance stacks.

cmd:appearance.setActiveItem.label: Select Appearance Item
cmd:appearance.setActiveItem.params: {index: paint-order item index in the first selected object's stack | null} make that fill/stroke row the target of the paint.setFill/setStroke, stroke.set/setAdvanced, paint.editGradient/setGradientGeom, transparency.set and effect.* calls that omit `item` (a fill row brings the Fill proxy forward, a stroke row the Stroke proxy); null or any selection change clears it → {index}
cmd:appearance.setActiveItem.desc: Choose the appearance row that later paint, transparency and effect commands act on.

cmd:appearance.setItem.label: Appearance Item
cmd:appearance.setItem.params: {index: paint-order item index, ids? (default: the selection), target?: "object"|"contents", opacity?: 0..100, blend?: name, visible?: bool, weight?: pt (strokes), color?|none?|swatch?|gradient? (as paint.setFill)} edit one fill/stroke of each target object's own appearance stack
cmd:appearance.setItem.desc: Edit one fill or stroke of the selected objects: colour, opacity, blend mode, visibility or weight.

cmd:appearance.setNewArtBasic.label: New Art Has Basic Appearance
cmd:appearance.setNewArtBasic.params: {on?: bool (omitted: toggle)} the Appearance panel option (the preference newArtBasic, on by default): on, new art takes one fill and stroke (with the Stroke panel's options); off, the whole appearance of the last selected object (every fill, stroke and effect, opacity and blend mode) → {on}
cmd:appearance.setNewArtBasic.desc: Toggle whether new objects get a basic fill and stroke or the last selected object's whole appearance.

cmd:appearance.showAllHidden.label: Show All Hidden Attributes
cmd:appearance.showAllHidden.params: {ids?, target?} make every hidden fill, stroke and effect (the object's and each item's) of each selected object visible again; errors when nothing is hidden → {ids}
cmd:appearance.showAllHidden.desc: Make every hidden fill, stroke and effect of the selected objects visible again.

cmd:appearance.targetContents.label: Target Contents
cmd:appearance.targetContents.params: {ids?} select the members of the selected groups and layers (or `ids`), as double-clicking the Appearance panel's Contents row does: the panel then lists, and appearance edits change, their own appearance; errors when none has members → {ids}
cmd:appearance.targetContents.desc: Select the members of the selected groups and layers so appearance edits change their own look.

cmd:appearance.transfer.label: Move Appearance
cmd:appearance.transfer.params: {source: id, target: id, copy?: bool} give `target` (a layer, group or object) the appearance (fills, strokes, effects) and transparency (opacity, blend mode, isolation, knockout) of `source`, as dragging a target circle onto another in the Layers panel does; the source is left with a cleared appearance (as appearance.clear) unless `copy` (Alt-drag). Opacity masks stay; placed gradients keep their place relative to each object's bounds → {source, target}
cmd:appearance.transfer.desc: Move or copy the appearance and transparency of one layer, group or object to another.

cmd:artboard.convertToArtboards.label: Convert to Artboards
cmd:artboard.convertToArtboards.params: {} turn each selected object's bounds into a new artboard (the objects are removed) → {artboards}
cmd:artboard.convertToArtboards.desc: Turn each selected object's bounds into a new artboard and remove the objects.

cmd:artboard.delete.label: Delete Artboard
cmd:artboard.delete.desc: Delete an artboard from the document.

cmd:artboard.duplicate.label: Duplicate Artboard
cmd:artboard.duplicate.params: {index} copy placed right of the last artboard
cmd:artboard.duplicate.desc: Copy an artboard and place it to the right of the last artboard.

cmd:artboard.fitToArt.label: Fit to Artwork Bounds
cmd:artboard.fitToArt.desc: Fit an artboard to the bounds of all artwork on it.

cmd:artboard.fitToSelection.label: Fit to Selected Art
cmd:artboard.fitToSelection.desc: Fit an artboard to the bounds of the selected art.

cmd:artboard.move.label: Move Artboard
cmd:artboard.move.params: {index, dx, dy, moveArt?: bool} move an artboard (and the unlocked art fully inside it)
cmd:artboard.move.desc: Move an artboard by an offset, optionally moving the unlocked art inside it.

cmd:artboard.new.label: New Artboard
cmd:artboard.new.params: {x?, y?, width?, height?, name?} (default: right of the last)
cmd:artboard.new.desc: Add a new artboard at a given position and size.

cmd:artboard.rearrange.label: Rearrange All Artboards…
cmd:artboard.rearrange.params: {columns?: n (2), spacing?: pt (20), byColumn?: false, moveArtwork?: true} lay artboards out in a grid
cmd:artboard.rearrange.desc: Rearrange all artboards into a grid with set columns, spacing and order.

cmd:artboard.reorder.label: Move Artboard Up/Down
cmd:artboard.reorder.desc: Change an artboard's number, moving it up or down in the order.

cmd:artboard.setProps.label: Artboard Options…
cmd:artboard.setProps.desc: Rename an artboard or change its position and size.

cmd:attributes.info.label: Attributes
cmd:attributes.info.params: {ids?, item?} → {ids, overprintFill, overprintStroke, showCenter, imageMap: "none"|"rectangle"|"polygon", url, note, fillRule: "nonZero"|"evenOdd" (of the paths and compound paths in them), reversed (their subpaths run counter-clockwise on screen: Reverse Path Direction On), recentUrls: [newest first]} the Attributes panel's values for `ids` or the selection, overprint aimed as object.setOverprint aims; a value is null where they differ (or nothing has a fill, stroke or path)
cmd:attributes.info.desc: Report attributes of the selected objects: overprint, centre point, image map, url, note and fill rule.

cmd:attributes.openUrl.label: Browser
cmd:attributes.openUrl.params: {url?} open url, else the selection's URL (attributes.info), in the web browser (the Attributes panel's Browser button) → {url}
cmd:attributes.openUrl.desc: Open a url, or the selected object's link, in the web browser.

cmd:attributes.set.label: Attributes
cmd:attributes.set.params: {overprintFill?: bool, overprintStroke?: bool (aimed as object.setOverprint's fill and stroke, item? too), showCenter?: bool (the canvas shows the selected object's centre point), imageMap?: "none"|"rectangle"|"polygon", url?: string ("" removes it; SVG export links the object), note?: string, ids?} set the Attributes panel's values on ids or the selection, as one undo step; a URL given joins the recent URLs (attributes.info) → {changed: objects}
cmd:attributes.set.desc: Set attributes of the selected objects: overprint, centre point, image map, url or note.

cmd:brush.apply.label: Apply Brush
cmd:brush.apply.params: {name, ids?} apply a brush to the strokes of the selected paths (adds a stroke if missing) and make it current → {ids}
cmd:brush.apply.desc: Apply a brush to the strokes of the selected paths and make it current.

cmd:brush.delete.label: Delete Brush
cmd:brush.delete.params: {name} delete a brush; strokes using it become plain strokes
cmd:brush.delete.desc: Delete a brush; strokes using it become plain strokes.

cmd:brush.duplicate.label: Duplicate Brush
cmd:brush.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a brush under a new name.

cmd:brush.freehand.label: Paintbrush
cmd:brush.freehand.params: {…path.freehand params, brush} paint a freehand stroke with a brush → {id}
cmd:brush.freehand.desc: Paint a freehand stroke with a brush.

cmd:brush.get.label: Brush Definition
cmd:brush.get.desc: Get the definition of a brush as json.

cmd:brush.list.label: Brushes
cmd:brush.list.desc: List all brushes and which one is current.

cmd:brush.new.label: New Brush…
cmd:brush.new.params: {type: calligraphic|scatter|art|pattern|bristle, name?, params?: {…definition fields}, ids?} new brush; art/scatter/pattern brushes take the selected art (pattern: side tile) unless params give it → {name}
cmd:brush.new.desc: Create a new calligraphic, scatter, art, pattern or bristle brush, optionally from selected art.

cmd:brush.options.label: Brush Options…
cmd:brush.options.params: {name, params?: {…fields to change}, newName?} edit a brush definition (strokes using it update) → {name}
cmd:brush.options.desc: Edit a brush definition so strokes using it update.

cmd:brush.remove.label: Remove Brush Stroke
cmd:brush.remove.params: {ids?} remove brushes from the selected strokes → {ids}
cmd:brush.remove.desc: Remove brushes from the selected strokes, leaving plain strokes.

cmd:brush.setCurrent.label: Current Brush
cmd:brush.setCurrent.params: {name: string|null} the brush the Paintbrush tool paints with (not an undo step)
cmd:brush.setCurrent.desc: Choose the brush the paintbrush tool paints with.

cmd:charStyle.apply.label: Apply Character Style
cmd:charStyle.apply.params: {name, clearOverrides?, ids?|id + start?/end? (a Type tool range)} → {count}
cmd:charStyle.apply.desc: Apply a character style to text, optionally clearing manual overrides.

cmd:charStyle.delete.label: Delete Character Style
cmd:charStyle.delete.desc: Delete a character style; the text keeps its look.

cmd:charStyle.duplicate.label: Duplicate Character Style
cmd:charStyle.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a character style under a new name.

cmd:charStyle.list.label: Character Styles
cmd:charStyle.list.desc: List all character styles with their attributes and use counts.

cmd:charStyle.new.label: New Character Style
cmd:charStyle.new.desc: Create a character style, by default from the selected text's formatting.

cmd:charStyle.redefine.label: Redefine Character Style
cmd:charStyle.redefine.params: {name, id?, start?} from the selected text; users keep their overrides
cmd:charStyle.redefine.desc: Redefine a character style from the selected text's formatting.

cmd:charStyle.setAttrs.label: Character Style Options
cmd:charStyle.setAttrs.params: {name, attrs: {…}} replace the style's attributes; users keep their overrides
cmd:charStyle.setAttrs.desc: Replace a character style's attributes; text using the style keeps manual overrides.

cmd:clipboard.exportSvg.label: Clipboard as SVG
cmd:clipboard.exportSvg.params: {} → {svg} the copied objects as standalone SVG (null when the clipboard is empty)
cmd:clipboard.exportSvg.desc: Get the copied objects as standalone svg text from the clipboard.

cmd:clipboard.importSvg.label: Load SVG into Clipboard
cmd:clipboard.importSvg.params: {svg | dataBase64 (SVG or SVGZ bytes), center?: [x, y]} replace the clipboard with the SVG's objects, centred on `center` (default: the first artboard) → {count}; then run edit.pasteInPlace
cmd:clipboard.importSvg.desc: Replace the clipboard with objects from svg text, centred on a point.

cmd:color.convert.label: Convert Color
cmd:color.convert.params: {color, to: "rgb"|"cmyk"|"gray"|"lab", intent?} → {model, values, hex, lab: [L,a,b], outOfGamut, deltaE}
cmd:color.convert.desc: Convert a colour between rgb, cmyk, gray and lab and report gamut and hex.

cmd:color.gamutCheck.label: Gamut Warning
cmd:color.gamutCheck.params: {ids?, colors?: [color]} colours that can't be printed in the working CMYK (selection, or the whole document when nothing is selected) → {checked, outOfGamut: [{hex, deltaE, count}]}
cmd:color.gamutCheck.desc: Warn which colours of the selection or document cannot be printed in the working cmyk.

cmd:color.harmony.label: Color Guide
cmd:color.harmony.params: {color, rule: complementary|complementary2|splitComplementary|leftComplement|rightComplement|analogous|analogous2|monochromatic|shades|triad|triad2|triad3|tetrad|tetrad2|tetrad3|compound|compound2|highContrast|highContrast2|highContrast3|pentagram (or its label), steps?: 1..20 (4), variation?: "tintsShades"|"warmCool"|"vividMuted", amount?: 0..100 (50; how far the outermost steps go), limitTo?: swatch library id or name, or "document" (the document's swatches): every colour snaps to its nearest colour there (ΔE 2000)} the Color Guide for a base colour → {rule, colors: ["#rrggbb", the base first], grid: [per colour, 2·steps+1 variations from shades/cool/muted to tints/warm/vivid with the colour itself in the centre]}
cmd:color.harmony.desc: Generate colour harmonies such as complementary, analogous or triad from a base colour.

cmd:color.loadProfile.label: Load Color Profile…
cmd:color.loadProfile.params: {path: .icc/.icm file} register an ICC profile (native only) → {name, kind}
cmd:color.loadProfile.desc: Register an icc colour profile from a file.

cmd:color.plates.label: Plates
cmd:color.plates.desc: Report the separation plates with their spot state and visibility.

cmd:colorTheme.addToSwatches.label: Add to Swatches
cmd:colorTheme.addToSwatches.params: {name} add a saved theme's colours to the Swatches panel as a colour group named after it (as swatch.newGroup), as one undo step → {name: the group's, swatches: [names]}
cmd:colorTheme.addToSwatches.desc: Add a saved colour theme's colours to the swatches panel as a colour group.

cmd:colorTheme.list.label: Color Themes
cmd:colorTheme.list.params: {} the saved colour themes, in order → {themes: [{name, colors: ["#rrggbb"], keys: [colour keys, exact in each colour's model], rule?}]}
cmd:colorTheme.list.desc: List the saved colour themes with their colours.

cmd:colorTheme.save.label: Save Theme
cmd:colorTheme.save.params: {colors: [1–5 colours] | color + rule (a harmony rule id or label, see color.harmony: its 5-colour theme from that base colour, base first), rule?: the rule it was made with, name?: (default "Theme N"), replace?: a saved theme's name (overwrite that theme in place, e.g. after editing it; it may be renamed)} save a colour theme to the local theme library (the preferences) → {name, count: themes saved}
cmd:colorTheme.save.desc: Save colours, or a harmony from a base colour, as a named colour theme.

cmd:command.batch.label: Batch
cmd:command.batch.params: {label?, commands: [{command, params}]} run several commands as ONE undo step; stops at the first error and rolls back
cmd:command.batch.desc: Run several commands as one undo step, rolling back on the first error.

cmd:document.activate.label: Activate Document
cmd:document.activate.desc: Make the document at an index the active document.

cmd:document.export.label: Export Document
cmd:document.export.params: {path?, format?: svg|svgz|pdf|png|jpg|webp|vectorcraft (default: from the path's extension, else png), artboard?: 0, artboards?: [i…], range?: "1-3, 5" | "all" (1-based; PDF writes one page per artboard, default all; SVG writes one file per artboard, {stem}-{artboard}.svg; raster formats write one artboard), scale?: 1 (raster), quality?: 90 (jpg), SVG options flat or as svg: {styling, outlineText, images, objectIds, decimals, minify, responsive, useArtboards, preserveEditing, metadata, fewerTspans} (see document.formats), …the PDF options of document.exportPdf} → {path, format, bytes, warnings, files?: [path…] (several), linked?: [path…] (linked images)}; no path → {dataBase64, format, bytes, warnings, files?: [{name, dataBase64}], linked?: [{name, dataBase64}]}. Never changes the document's path
cmd:document.export.desc: Export the document or chosen artboards to svg, pdf, png, jpg or webp.

cmd:document.exportForScreens.label: Export for Screens
cmd:document.exportForScreens.params: {folder?, artboards?: [index…] | range?: "1-3" (default all), formats?: [{format: png|jpg|webp|svg|svgz|pdf, scale?: 1 (raster only), suffix?: "@2x" (raster default: @{scale}x when scale ≠ 1; vector formats drop @Nx suffixes)}], prefix?} one file per artboard and format (a PDF holds its artboard alone; artboards with the same name, in any case, get -2, -3…; an unnamed one is Artboard-N) → {files: [path…]}; no folder → {files: [{name, dataBase64}]}
cmd:document.exportForScreens.desc: Export artboards in several formats and scales at once, one file per artboard.

cmd:document.exportPdf.label: Export PDF
cmd:document.exportPdf.params: {path?, preset?: "VectorCraft Default", artboard? | artboards?: [i…] | range?: "1-3, 5" (1-based; default all, one page each), standard?: none|pdfA2b|pdfX1a|pdfX3|pdfX4, compatibility?: 1.4|1.5|1.6|1.7 (default)|2.0, preserveEditing?, thumbnails?, fastWebView?, viewAfterSaving? (the app opens the written file), createLayers?, compression?: {color?, gray?: {downsample: none|average|subsample|bicubic, ppi: 300, abovePpi: 450, compression: none|zip|jpeg|jpeg2000|auto, quality: minimum|low|medium|high|maximum}, mono?: {downsample, ppi: 1200, abovePpi: 1800, compression: none|ccittG3|ccittG4|zip|runLength}, compressText?: true}, marks?: {trim, registration, colorBars, pageInfo, kind: roman|japanese, weight: 0.25, offset: 6}, bleed?: {useDocument, top, bottom, left, right} (pt), output?: {conversion: none|destination|preserveNumbers, destination, profiles: none|all|destination|taggedSource, outputIntent, outputCondition, outputConditionId, registry, trapped}, advanced?: {fontSubsetPercent: 100, outlineText: true, overprint: preserve|discard}, security?: {openPassword, permissionsPassword, printing: none|low|high, changes: none|pages|forms|comments|any, copy, screenReader, plaintextMetadata}} → {path, bytes, warnings}; no path → {dataBase64, bytes, warnings}. The options apply over the preset (null keeps its value); options accepted but not applied yet come back as warnings; PDF/X, passwords and PDF/A-2b at 2.0 are refused. document.export {format: pdf} takes the same options
cmd:document.exportPdf.desc: Export the document as a pdf with standards, presets and per-artboard pages.

cmd:document.exportSelection.label: Export Selection…
cmd:document.exportSelection.params: {path?, format?: png|jpg|webp|svg|svgz|pdf (default: from the extension, else png), scale?: 1, …the format's options} the selected objects cropped to their bounds (template layers left out) → {path, bytes, bounds} (no path → {dataBase64, bounds})
cmd:document.exportSelection.desc: Export only the selected objects, cropped to their bounds, as png, jpg, svg or other formats.

cmd:document.formats.label: File Formats
cmd:document.formats.params: {} → {formats: [{id, label, extensions, mime, read, write, raster, options: {name: {type, default, description}}}], readable: [id…], writable: [id…], openExtensions: [ext…]}
cmd:document.formats.desc: List the file formats the app can read and write with their options.

cmd:document.info.label: Document Info
cmd:document.info.params: {selectionOnly?} → {document, objects: {paths, compoundPaths, groups, …}, fonts, images, swatches, graphicStyleNames (with selectionOnly: the styles the selected objects are linked to), …}
cmd:document.info.desc: Report document statistics: object counts, fonts, images, swatches and more.

cmd:document.inspect.label: Inspect Document
cmd:document.inspect.desc: Inspect the layer tree, artboards, selection and history of the document.

cmd:document.json.label: Document JSON
cmd:document.json.desc: Get the complete document model as json.

cmd:document.node.label: Inspect Object
cmd:document.node.desc: Get the full json of one object by its id.

cmd:document.open.label: Open Document
cmd:document.open.params: {path} or {name, dataBase64} → {index, title, format, warnings}; any readable format (see document.formats): .vectorcraft/.drawcraft, .svg/.svgz, .pdf/.ai, .ait, PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/TIFF/BMP (an image opens as a document of its pixel size). Templates (native templates, .ait) open as a new untitled document
cmd:document.open.desc: Open a file as a document: native, svg, pdf, ai or a raster image.

cmd:document.pdfSettings.label: PDF Settings
cmd:document.pdfSettings.params: {preset?, includeDocument?: false, …document.exportPdf options} → {settings (the preset with the options applied), presets: [name…], changed: [{option: "compression.compressText", value}] (what differs from the defaults), warnings}; includeDocument also exports the active document in memory and adds its warnings (pattern strokes, effects left out…)
cmd:document.pdfSettings.desc: Show or change the document's pdf export settings and presets.

cmd:document.rasterEffectsSettings.label: Document Raster Effects Settings…
cmd:document.rasterEffectsSettings.params: {resolution?: ppi (1–2400) | "screen" (72) | "medium" (150) | "high" (300)} resolution of raster effects in PDF export and Rasterize; no params → {resolution}
cmd:document.rasterEffectsSettings.desc: Set the resolution used by raster effects in pdf export and rasterizing.

cmd:document.save.label: Save Document
cmd:document.save.params: {path?, format?: vectorcraft|svg|svgz (default: from the path's extension, else vectorcraft), svg?: {…SVG options, see document.formats}} (default path: the document's) → {path, linked?}; the document takes the path. cmd:document.save.desc: Save the document in its native format or as svg, defaulting to its current path.

cmd:document.serialize.label: Serialize Document
cmd:document.serialize.params: {format?: vectorcraft (default)|svg|svgz|pdf|png|jpg|webp, …the format's options (see document.formats; SVG ones also as svg: {…})} → {text, warnings} for svg, else {dataBase64, warnings}; an SVG of several artboards also gives files: [{name, text}], linked images linked: [{name, dataBase64}]
cmd:document.serialize.desc: Serialize the document to a chosen format in memory, without touching files.

cmd:document.setUnits.label: Units
cmd:document.setUnits.params: {units: "Points"|"Picas"|"Inches"|"Millimeters"|"Centimeters"|"Pixels"|"Feet & Inches"|"Meters"|"Yards"|"Feet"} the document's units: every length the UI shows and reads (General)
cmd:document.setUnits.desc: Set the document's measurement units for everything the interface shows.

cmd:edit.assignProfile.label: Assign Profile…
cmd:edit.assignProfile.params: {rgb?: profile|null, cmyk?: profile|null} tag the document with profiles (colour numbers are kept) → {rgb, cmyk}
cmd:edit.assignProfile.desc: Tag the document with rgb or cmyk colour profiles without converting colour numbers.

cmd:edit.colorSettings.label: Color Settings…
cmd:edit.colorSettings.params: {rgb?: profile, cmyk?: profile, intent?: "perceptual"|"relative"|"saturation"|"absolute", bpc?: bool} set the working spaces → {rgb, cmyk, intent, bpc, profiles: [{name, kind, builtin}]}
cmd:edit.colorSettings.desc: Set the working colour spaces and rendering intent for colour conversions.

cmd:edit.colors.adjustBalance.label: Adjust Color Balance…
cmd:edit.colors.adjustBalance.params: {mode?: "rgb"|"cmyk"|"gray"|"global" (default: from the channels given), r?, g?, b? | c?, m?, y?, k? | gray? | tint?: -100..100 (% added per channel, default 0; `tint` is global mode: it shifts the tints of colours and gradient stops linked to global and spot swatches, which stay linked, and leaves other colours and images alone), convert?: false (true: the results stay in the adjusted model; false: each colour keeps its own), fill?, stroke?, includeImages?, includePatterns?, ids?} reaching what edit.colors.invert does → {changed}
cmd:edit.colors.adjustBalance.desc: Shift the colour balance of the selection channel by channel, or tint global colours.

cmd:edit.colors.blendFrontToBack.label: Blend Front to Back
cmd:edit.colors.blendFrontToBack.params: {} ≥3 filled objects (solid fills or gradient meshes, which keep their shading): intermediate fills graded between the frontmost and backmost fill → {changed}
cmd:edit.colors.blendFrontToBack.desc: Grade the fills of three or more stacked objects between the front and back colours.

cmd:edit.colors.blendHorizontally.label: Blend Horizontally

cmd:effect.apply.label: Apply Effect
cmd:effect.apply.params: {effect: id (see effect.list, e.g. "stylize.dropShadow", "distort.roughen", "warp.arc"), params?: {…} (missing keys take the dialog defaults), item?: appearance item index|null (apply to that fill/stroke only; omitted: the Appearance panel's active item, else the whole object), ids?: [..] (layers too), target?: "object"|"contents" (contents: the objects inside groups and layers)} append a live effect to each selected object's appearance (a group's or layer's apply to its members as one piece: one combined shadow) → {ids, index, item}

cmd:effect.applyLast.label: Apply Last Effect

cmd:effect.dialog.label: Effect…

cmd:effect.dialog.desc: Open an effect's options dialog, optionally editing an already applied effect in place.

cmd:effect.duplicate.label: Duplicate Effect
cmd:effect.duplicate.params: {index: int, item?: appearance item index|null (as effect.remove), ids?: [..]} insert a copy of the effect right after it → {ids}
cmd:effect.duplicate.desc: Insert a copy of an applied effect right after it.

cmd:effect.expandAppearance.label: Expand Appearance
cmd:effect.expandAppearance.params: {ids?: [..], target?} turn each object's appearance into objects: every fill and stroke becomes an object of its own (strokes outlined, brushed strokes their brush art) grouped in paint order under the object's id and transparency, geometry effects are baked, raster effects become an embedded image (shadows and outer glows below the art; blur, feather and inner glow replace it), type with effects or fills of its own is outlined; Crop Marks become a group of the object and its marks; a group's or layer's own fills and strokes become objects among its members, which are expanded too. cmd:effect.last.desc: Open the options dialog of the last effect applied.

cmd:effect.list.label: Effects
cmd:effect.list.params: {} → {catalog: [{id, label, menu, params, defaults, raster, lengths: {always, absolute (while relative is false)} (distance params Scale Strokes & Effects scales)}], applied: [{id, effects, items: [{index, kind: fill|stroke, effects}]}], activeItem} for the selection
cmd:effect.list.desc: List the effect catalogue and the effects applied to the selection.

cmd:effect.move.label: Move Effect
cmd:effect.move.params: {from: int (position in the source list), to: int (its position in the destination list afterwards), fromItem?: appearance item index|null (the source list: that fill/stroke's effects, null the object's; omitted: the active item, else the object's), toItem?: item index|null (the destination list; default: the source list), copy?: bool (copy instead of move, as Alt-dragging the row), ids?: [..]} reorder an effect or move it between the object and its fills/strokes, as one undo step → {ids, index, item}
cmd:effect.move.desc: Move an effect to another position in the appearance order, even onto another fill or stroke.

cmd:effect.remove.label: Remove Effect

cmd:effect.remove.desc: Remove an applied effect from the object or from a fill or stroke.

cmd:effect.setParams.label: Effect Options

cmd:effect.setParams.desc: Change the parameters of an applied effect, or toggle its visibility.

cmd:eyedropper.setOptions.label: Eyedropper Options
cmd:eyedropper.setOptions.params: {sampleSize?: 1|3|5 (pixels square averaged when sampling an image: point, 3×3, 5×5), pickUp?, apply?: {appearance?: {transparency?, fill?: {color?, transparency?, overprint?}, stroke?: {color?, transparency?, overprint?, weight?, cap?, join?, miter?, dash?}}, character?, paragraph?} (bools; a bool for a branch sets all of it)} Eyedropper Options, kept in the preferences: what appearance.copyFrom picks up from the clicked object and applies (only attributes in both trees are copied; every fill and stroke attribute copies the whole appearance stack); {} reads them → the options
cmd:eyedropper.setOptions.desc: Set what the eyedropper picks up and applies: fills, strokes, text and more.

cmd:flattener.presets.save.params: {name?: (default: a new "Flattener Preset N"), newName?: rename it, preset?: the preset to start from (default: the saved preset `name`, else medium), …options (the keys of object.flattenTransparency, at the top level or in `options`)} create or change a saved preset (built-in ones can't change) → {name, options, created}

cmd:graphicStyle.addFromLibrary.label: Add to Graphic Styles

cmd:graphicStyle.apply.params: {name, add?: bool, ids? cmd:graphicStyle.breakLink.label: Break Link to Graphic Style
cmd:graphicStyle.breakLink.params: {ids?} unlink the objects (default: the selection) from their graphic style; they keep their look
cmd:graphicStyle.breakLink.desc: Unlink objects from their graphic style while keeping their look.

cmd:graphicStyle.delete.label: Delete Graphic Style
cmd:graphicStyle.delete.params: {name} | {names: [name…]} delete styles; their objects keep their look but are unlinked

cmd:graphicStyle.duplicate.label: Duplicate Graphic Style
cmd:graphicStyle.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a graphic style under a new name.

cmd:graphicStyle.libraries.desc: List every graphic style library the library panel can open.

cmd:graphicStyle.redefine.params: {name?, id?} replace the style (default: the one the object was last linked to) with the look of object `id` or the first selected object; the objects still linked to it update, and that object becomes linked → {name}

cmd:object.repeat.options.params: {instances?, radius?, reverseOverlap?, startAngle?, endAngle?, center?: [x,y] | hSpacing?, vSpacing?, rows?, cols?, gridType?, flipRows?, flipCols? | angle?} set the options of the selected repeats
cmd:object.repeat.options.desc: Change the options of the selected repeats: instances, spacing, rows or angle.

cmd:object.repeat.radial.label: Radial
cmd:object.repeat.radial.params: {ids?, instances?: n (8), radius?: pt} radial repeat of the selection (or switch the selected repeat to radial) → {id}
cmd:object.repeat.radial.desc: Repeat the selection in a circle around a centre.

cmd:object.repeat.release.label: Release
cmd:object.repeat.release.params: {} release the selected repeats back to their source art → {ids}
cmd:object.repeat.release.desc: Release the selected repeats back to their source art.

cmd:object.resetBoundingBox.label: Reset Bounding Box
cmd:object.resetBoundingBox.params: {} no-op: VectorCraft bounding boxes are always axis-aligned to the document → {changed: 0}
cmd:object.resetBoundingBox.desc: Do nothing: bounding boxes are always axis-aligned in vectorcraft.

cmd:object.rotate.label: Rotate…
cmd:object.rotate.desc: Rotate the selected objects by an angle around a chosen origin.

cmd:object.scale.label: Scale…
cmd:object.scale.params: {sx: %, sy?: %, origin?: [x,y], copy?, strokes?: bool (Scale Strokes & Effects: stroke weights, dashes and effect distances scale; off keeps them, type strokes included), corners?: bool (Scale Corners: live corner radii scale)} (strokes/corners default to the preferences)
cmd:object.scale.desc: Scale the selected objects by percentages, with options for strokes and corners.

cmd:object.setBounds.label: Set Bounds
cmd:object.setBounds.params: {x?, y?, width?, height?, reference?: 0..8 (9-point grid), proportional?, strokes?, corners?} (Transform panel; with Use Preview Bounds the values measure the visual bounds; strokes/corners as object.scale)
cmd:object.setBounds.desc: Set the exact position and size of each selected object.

cmd:object.setLiveShape.label: Live Shape Properties
cmd:object.setLiveShape.desc: Set the corner radius or side count of a live shape.

cmd:object.setOverprint.label: Overprint
cmd:object.setOverprint.params: {fill?: bool, stroke?: bool, item?: appearance item index|null, ids?} make fills and/or strokes overprint (Overprint Preview, Separations Preview) or knock out: item's, else every fill or stroke of the painted objects (groups: their contents; type: its characters too). Without item and ids, the Appearance panel's active item stands in when it is of that kind → {changed: objects}
cmd:object.setOverprint.desc: Make the fills or strokes of the selection overprint or knock out.

cmd:object.setProps.label: Object Properties
cmd:object.setProps.params: {ids?|id?, name?, visible?, locked?, opacity?: 0..100, blend?: "Multiply"…, isolate?, knockout?: "on"|"off"|"neutral"|bool (true = on, false = neutral), knockoutShape?: bool}
cmd:object.setProps.desc: Rename objects or change their visibility, lock, opacity, blend mode or isolation.

cmd:object.shape.convertToShape.label: Convert to Shape
cmd:object.shape.convertToShape.params: {} turn paths that are rectangles (any rotation) or axis-aligned ellipses into live shapes → {converted}
cmd:object.shape.convertToShape.desc: Turn rectangles and ellipses that are drawn as paths back into live shapes.

cmd:object.shear.label: Shear…
cmd:object.shear.desc: Slant the selected objects along an axis by an angle.

cmd:object.showAll.label: Show All
cmd:object.showAll.desc: Show all objects hidden with the hide command.

cmd:object.textWrap.make.label: Make
cmd:object.textWrap.make.params: {offset?: pt (6), invert?: bool, ids?} area type below the selected objects (same layer) wraps around them → {ids}
cmd:object.textWrap.make.desc: Make area text wrap around the selected objects.

cmd:object.textWrap.options.label: Text Wrap Options…
cmd:object.textWrap.options.params: {offset?: pt, invert?: bool, ids?} set the options of the selected wrap objects; no options → the current {offset, invert}
cmd:object.textWrap.options.desc: Set the offset or inversion of the selected text wraps.

cmd:object.textWrap.release.label: Release
cmd:object.textWrap.release.desc: Release text wraps so text flows normally.

cmd:object.transform.label: Transform
cmd:object.transform.params: {matrix: [a,b,c,d,e,f], copy?: bool, ids?, strokes?: bool, corners?: bool} apply an affine to the selection (or ids); strokes/corners: Scale Strokes & Effects / Scale Corners (default: the preferences)
cmd:object.transform.desc: Apply an affine transformation matrix to the selection.

cmd:object.transformAgain.label: Transform Again
cmd:object.transformAgain.desc: Repeat the last transformation on the selection.

cmd:object.transformEach.label: Transform Each…
cmd:object.transformEach.params: {scaleH?: % (100), scaleV?: % (100), moveH?: pt, moveV?: pt (down = +), rotate?: deg (counter-clockwise), reflectX?: bool (flip vertically), reflectY?: bool (flip horizontally), random?: bool, seed?: n, reference?: 0..8 (9-point grid, 4 = centre), copy?: bool, strokes?: bool (Scale Strokes & Effects), corners?: bool (Scale Corners; both default to the preferences)} transform every selected object about its own reference point → {ids}
cmd:object.transformEach.desc: Transform each selected object separately by scale, move, rotate or reflect.

cmd:object.unlockAll.label: Unlock All
cmd:object.unlockAll.desc: Unlock every locked object in the document.

cmd:paint.complement.label: Complement
cmd:paint.complement.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} replace the active proxy's colours by their complements ((highest + lowest) − each component, over RGB or CMY; grey unchanged) keeping each colour's model; honours the Appearance panel's active item as paint.invert does; with nothing selected, the default → {changed}
cmd:paint.complement.desc: Replace the active fill or stroke colours by their complements.

cmd:paint.default.label: Default Fill and Stroke
cmd:paint.default.params: {ids?} white fill and 1 pt black stroke for the selection and the defaults; type gets black fill and no stroke
cmd:paint.default.desc: Reset to the default white fill and black stroke.

cmd:paint.editGradient.label: Gradient
cmd:paint.editGradient.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), kind?: linear|radial|freeform (freeform places points on each object, coloured along the stops), mode?: points|lines (freeform: how the Gradient tool adds points), stops?: [{offset 0..1, color? (needed without swatch), opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), midpoint? 0.13..0.87, swatch?: colour swatch name (a global or spot colour or tint swatch links the stop, so swatch edits recolour it and a spot stop prints on its plate; a process colour just gives its colour), tint?: 0..100 (% of the linked swatch; default 100, or a tint swatch's own)}] (at least 2; a freeform gradient's points are recoloured along them), angle?: deg, aspect?: %, reverse?: bool, item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind), ids?, strokeMode?: within|along|across (strokes only: the gradient lies on the page and shows through the stroke, runs from the start of each subpath to its end, or runs from the stroke's left edge to its right all along it; with nothing selected, for the next object drawn; type characters' own strokes always paint within)} edit the gradient in place (keeps its placement); solid/none paints become the default gradient
cmd:paint.editGradient.desc: Edit a gradient's kind, stops, angle and other properties on the selection.

cmd:paint.freeform.addLine.label: Add Freeform Line
cmd:paint.freeform.addLine.params: {points: [index, …] (at least two), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} join points with a smooth line through them, in order → {line}
cmd:paint.freeform.addLine.desc: Join freeform gradient colour points with a smooth line of blended colour.

cmd:paint.freeform.addPoint.label: Add Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.addPoint.params: {at: [x,y] (document coordinates), color? (default: the gradient's colour there), opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), spread? 0..1 (or 0..100 %; the radius of pure colour around the point, a fraction of half the object's larger side; default 0), line?: true (join it to the selected point: extends the line ending there, else starts one), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} add a point to the freeform gradient (an unplaced one keeps its automatic points first) and select it → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.addPoint.desc: Add a colour point to a freeform gradient at a position.

cmd:paint.freeform.deletePoint.label: Delete Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.deletePoint.params: {index? (default: the selected point), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} remove a point (never the last one); lines through it close up around it and lines left with one point go → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.deletePoint.desc: Delete a point from a freeform gradient.

cmd:paint.freeform.get.label: Freeform Gradient
cmd:paint.freeform.get.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy)} the freeform gradient behind the proxy of the first selected object → {mode: points|lines, points: [{at: [x,y] (document coordinates), color, opacity, spread}], lines: [[index, …]], selected: index|null}
cmd:paint.freeform.get.desc: Read the freeform gradient applied to the first selected object.

cmd:paint.freeform.selectPoint.label: Select Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.selectPoint.params: {index: point index | null to clear} select a point of the freeform gradient behind the active proxy (the first selected object's): the point the Gradient tool, the Gradient and Color panels and Delete act on → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.selectPoint.desc: Select a point of the freeform gradient being edited.

cmd:paint.freeform.setPoint.label: Edit Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.setPoint.params: {index? (default: the selected point), at?: [x,y] (document coordinates), color?, opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), spread? 0..1 (or 0..100 %), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} move or recolour a point of the freeform gradient → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.setPoint.desc: Move a freeform gradient point or change its colour, opacity or spread.

cmd:paint.freeform.splitLine.label: Split Freeform Line
cmd:paint.freeform.splitLine.params: {line: line index, segment: the segment from the line's point `segment` to the next, t?: 0..1 along it (default 0.5), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} add a point on a line there (colour, opacity and spread between the segment's ends) and select it → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.splitLine.desc: Split a freeform gradient line into two at a point.

cmd:paint.invert.label: Invert
cmd:paint.invert.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} invert the active proxy's colours of the selection (or ids; groups recolour their contents) keeping each colour's model, as edit.colors.invert does; the Appearance panel's active fill/stroke item (appearance.setActiveItem) is inverted instead when it is of that kind and no ids are given; with nothing selected, invert the default → {changed}
cmd:paint.invert.desc: Invert the colours of the active fill or stroke on the selection.

cmd:paint.lastColor.label: Apply Last Color
cmd:paint.lastColor.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} apply the last solid colour used (paint.recent lastColor) to the active proxy of the selection and the default
cmd:paint.lastColor.desc: Apply the most recently used solid colour again.

cmd:paint.lastGradient.label: Apply Last Gradient
cmd:paint.lastGradient.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} apply the last gradient used (paint.recent lastGradient), fitted to each object, to the active proxy of the selection and the default
cmd:paint.lastGradient.desc: Apply the most recently used gradient again, fitted to each object.

cmd:paint.none.label: None
cmd:paint.none.params: {} set the active proxy (fill or stroke) to None
cmd:paint.none.desc: Set the active fill or stroke to none.

cmd:paint.proxies.label: Fill and Stroke
cmd:paint.proxies.params: {} → {fill, stroke: the paints the Fill/Stroke proxies show (the Appearance panel's active item for the proxy of its kind, else the first selected object's, a group's first painted object's, type: its first run's; else the defaults for new art), fillActive, fillMixed, strokeMixed: the selected objects' (or a selected group's contents') fills (strokes) differ, shown as a "?" proxy}
cmd:paint.proxies.desc: Report the current fill and stroke paints behind the fill and stroke proxies.

cmd:paint.recent.label: Recent Colors
cmd:paint.recent.params: {} → {colors: [{hex, color}] newest first (fed by every paint command and the eyedropper), lastColor: {hex, color}, lastGradient: gradient paint}
cmd:paint.recent.desc: List the recently used colours, last colour and last gradient.

cmd:paint.sampleColor.label: Sample Color
cmd:paint.sampleColor.params: {color, stroke?: bool (default: whichever proxy is active), ids?, stop?: index} sample a colour into the active fill/stroke (and the selection); with `stop`, recolour that stop of the gradient behind the proxy instead (paint.editGradient)
cmd:paint.sampleColor.desc: Sample a colour into the active fill or stroke, or into a gradient stop.

cmd:paint.setFill.label: Fill
cmd:paint.setFill.params: {color?: "#rrggbb"|[r,g,b]|{c,m,y,k}|{gray}|{l,a,b} (CIE Lab), none?: true, swatch?: name (a global or spot colour stays linked, so swatch edits recolour it; a tint swatch links to its base at its tint; a gradient swatch is recorded as the gradient's swatch and fits each object, keeping its aspect; the built-in "[Registration]" prints on every plate), tint?: 0..100 (% of a global or spot `swatch`; default 100, or a tint swatch's own), gradient?: {kind?: linear|radial|freeform, stops?: [{offset 0..1, color, opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), midpoint? 0.13..0.87, swatch?: global or spot colour (or tint) swatch the stop links to (its colour comes from the swatch), tint?: 0..100}] (at least 2; default white→black), angle?: deg, start?: [x,y], end?: [x,y] (the vector in document coordinates, both or neither; type objects keep it in text space), aspect?: % (radial; without start/end the gradient is placed on each object's bounds), focal?: [x,y] (radial, with start/end: the focal point, where the first stop sits), swatch?: linked gradient swatch name}, item?: appearance item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item if it is a fill, else the top fill), ids?, focus?: true (false keeps the active proxy), keepModel?: false (in a CMYK document, RGB colours and gradient stops are stored as CMYK unless true; Gray stays Gray)} sets the selection's fill and the default (new art fits a gradient to itself)
cmd:paint.setFill.desc: Set the fill colour, swatch, gradient or none of the selection or defaults.

cmd:paint.setGradientGeom.label: Gradient Vector
cmd:paint.setGradientGeom.params: {start?: [x,y], end?: [x,y] (document coordinates; both or neither: omitted, the vector stays), aspect?: % (radial: the extent ellipse's height / width; default: kept), focal?: [x,y] (document coordinates) | null (radial: the focal point, where the first stop sits, pulled inside the extent ellipse; null centres it; default: it keeps its place in the ellipse), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (alias: index; omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} set the gradient vector, aspect ratio and focal point (solid paints become the default gradient; type objects set it on their runs, in text space)
cmd:paint.setGradientGeom.desc: Set a gradient's start and end points, aspect or focal point.

cmd:paint.setStroke.label: Stroke
cmd:paint.setStroke.params: same as paint.setFill, for the stroke (item?: the stroke item to set)
cmd:paint.setStroke.desc: Set the stroke colour, swatch, gradient or none of the selection or defaults.

cmd:paint.swap.label: Swap Fill and Stroke
cmd:paint.swap.params: {ids?} swap the fill and stroke of the selection (type too) and of the defaults
cmd:paint.swap.desc: Swap the fill and stroke of the selection.

cmd:paint.toggleActive.label: Toggle Fill/Stroke Focus
cmd:paint.toggleActive.params: {fill?: bool (true: bring the Fill proxy forward, false: the Stroke proxy; omitted: swap which is in front)} → {fillActive}
cmd:paint.toggleActive.desc: Bring the fill or stroke proxy forward as the active one.

cmd:paraStyle.apply.label: Apply Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.apply.params: {name, clearOverrides?, ids?|id + start?/end? (a Type tool range)} → {count}
cmd:paraStyle.apply.desc: Apply a paragraph style to text, optionally clearing overrides.

cmd:paraStyle.delete.label: Delete Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.delete.desc: Delete a paragraph style; the text keeps its look.

cmd:paraStyle.duplicate.label: Duplicate Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a paragraph style under a new name.

cmd:paraStyle.list.label: Paragraph Styles
cmd:paraStyle.list.desc: List all paragraph styles with their attributes and use counts.

cmd:paraStyle.new.label: New Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.new.desc: Create a paragraph style, by default from the selected text's formatting.

cmd:paraStyle.redefine.label: Redefine Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.redefine.params: {name, id?, start?} from the selected text; users keep their overrides
cmd:paraStyle.redefine.desc: Redefine a paragraph style from the selected text's formatting.

cmd:paraStyle.setAttrs.label: Paragraph Style Options
cmd:paraStyle.setAttrs.params: {name, attrs: {…}} replace the style's attributes; users keep their overrides
cmd:paraStyle.setAttrs.desc: Replace a paragraph style's attributes in its options.

cmd:path.appendAnchor.label: Add Anchor (Pen)

cmd:path.average.label: Average…
cmd:path.average.desc: Pull selected anchor points together on a horizontal, vertical or both axes.

cmd:path.blob.label: Blob Brush
cmd:path.blob.params: {points: [[x,y]…], size?: pt (10), merge?: true} filled brush shape, merged with touching same-colour blobs → {id}
cmd:path.blob.desc: Paint a filled blob stroke that merges with same-colour blobs.

cmd:path.close.label: Close Path
cmd:path.close.params: {id, in?: [x,y] (handle into the first anchor), independent?: bool}
cmd:path.close.desc: Close an open path, joining its endpoints.

cmd:path.convertAnchor.label: Convert Anchor Point
cmd:path.convertAnchor.params: {id, subpath, anchor, to: "corner"|"smooth", x?, y?} (smooth with x/y: out handle there, in handle mirrored)
cmd:path.convertAnchor.desc: Convert an anchor point between corner and smooth.

cmd:path.convertAnchors.label: Convert Anchor Points
cmd:path.convertAnchors.desc: Convert all selected anchor points between corner and smooth.

cmd:path.create.label: Create Path
cmd:path.create.params: {anchors: [{x, y, in?: [x,y], out?: [x,y]}], closed?: bool, d?: SVG path data} → {id}
cmd:path.create.desc: Create a path from anchor coordinates or svg path data.

cmd:path.curvature.label: Curvature
cmd:path.curvature.params: {points: [{x, y, corner?}], closed?, id?} create (or with id: replace) a path curving through the points → {id}
cmd:path.curvature.desc: Create or replace a path curving smoothly through given points.

cmd:path.cutAtAnchors.label: Cut Path at Selected Anchor Points
cmd:path.cutAtAnchors.desc: Cut the selected paths at their selected anchor points.

cmd:path.deleteAnchors.label: Remove Anchor Points
cmd:path.deleteAnchors.desc: Delete the directly selected anchor points.

cmd:path.eraseRegion.label: Eraser
cmd:path.eraseRegion.params: {points: [[x,y]…], size?: pt (10)} erase a round-brush stroke from paths (selected, or all) → {ids}
cmd:path.eraseRegion.desc: Erase part of paths with a round eraser brush stroke.

cmd:path.eraseSegments.label: Path Eraser
cmd:path.eraseSegments.params: {points: [[x,y]…], width?: pt (8)} erase the parts of selected paths under the drag → {ids}
cmd:path.eraseSegments.desc: Erase the parts of selected paths under the drag.

cmd:path.freehand.label: Pencil
cmd:path.freehand.params: {points: [[x,y]…], fidelity?: pt (1.5), closed?, style?: "pencil"|"brush", fill?: bool, extend?: {id, end: "start"|"end"}} fit a freehand stroke → {id}
cmd:path.freehand.desc: Fit a freehand pencil stroke through drawn points.

cmd:path.insertAnchor.label: Add Anchor Point
cmd:path.insertAnchor.desc: Insert an anchor point into a segment of a path.

cmd:path.join.label: Join
cmd:path.join.params: {} join two open paths' nearest endpoints, or close a single open path
cmd:path.join.desc: Join two open paths at their nearest endpoints, or close one open path.

cmd:path.joinScrub.label: Join
cmd:path.joinScrub.params: {points: [[x,y]…], tolerance?: pt (12)} join the open-path endpoints scrubbed over → {id}
cmd:path.joinScrub.desc: Join the open endpoints scrubbed over with the pointer.

cmd:path.knife.params: {points: [[x,y]…]} cut closed shapes (selected, or all when nothing is selected) along the polyline → {ids}
cmd:path.knife.desc: Cut closed shapes along a freehand polyline.

cmd:path.moveAnchors.label: Move Anchors
cmd:path.moveAnchors.params: {dx, dy} move direct-selected anchors (whole paths if fully selected)
cmd:path.moveAnchors.desc: Move the directly selected anchor points by an offset.

cmd:path.removeAnchor.label: Delete Anchor Point
cmd:path.removeAnchor.params: {id, subpath, anchor} remove one anchor, re-fitting the curve
cmd:path.removeAnchor.desc: Remove one anchor point, re-fitting the curve.

cmd:path.reshape.params: {id, x, y, dx, dy, tol=3, radius?} Reshape tool: grab the path at (x, y) (adding an anchor there unless one is within tol) and drag it by (dx, dy); nearby anchors follow with a smooth falloff over radius (default: half the subpath's size)

cmd:path.reshapeSegment.params: {id, subpath, segment, t, dx, dy} bend a segment so the point at t moves by (dx, dy)
cmd:path.reshapeSegment.desc: Bend a path segment so a point on it moves by an offset.

cmd:path.reverse.params: {ids?, reversed?: bool (true: every subpath runs counter-clockwise on screen, false: clockwise, the Attributes panel's Reverse Path Direction On / Off; omitted: flip each path)} the paths in ids or the selection (groups and compound paths: the paths inside), as one undo step → {changed: paths}
cmd:path.reverse.desc: Reverse the direction of paths, or set subpaths consistently clockwise or counter-clockwise.

cmd:path.setAnchors.params: {id, subpaths: [{anchors: [{x,y,in?,out?}], closed}]} replace a path's geometry
cmd:path.setAnchors.desc: Replace a path's whole geometry with new subpaths and anchors.

cmd:path.setFillRule.label: Fill Rule
cmd:path.setFillRule.params: {rule: "nonZero"|"evenOdd", ids?} the fill rule of the paths and compound paths in ids or the selection (groups: those inside), as one undo step → {changed}
cmd:path.setFillRule.desc: Set the fill rule of paths to nonzero or even-odd.

cmd:path.setHandle.label: Move Direction Handle
cmd:path.setHandle.params: {id, subpath, anchor, which: "in"|"out", x, y, independent?: bool}
cmd:path.setHandle.desc: Move a direction handle of an anchor point.

cmd:path.smoothRegion.label: Smooth
cmd:path.smoothRegion.params: {points: [[x,y]…], radius?: pt (12), fidelity?: pt (2.5)} smooth selected paths near the drag → {ids, before, after}
cmd:path.smoothRegion.desc: Smooth the selected paths near a dragged stroke.

cmd:path.split.label: Split Path
cmd:path.split.params: {id, subpath, segment, t} or {id, subpath, anchor}: closed paths open there, open paths become two → {ids}
cmd:path.split.desc: Open a closed path or split an open path at a point.

cmd:pattern.list.label: List Patterns

cmd:pattern.options.label: Pattern Options
cmd:pattern.options.params: {name? (default: the pattern being edited), newName?, tileType?, brickOffset?, width?, height?, hSpacing?, vSpacing?, sizeTileToArt?: bool, overlap?: {h: left|right, v: top|bottom}, copies?: 3|5|7|9, dimCopies?: %, showTileEdge?: bool, showSwatchBounds?: bool (outline the part of the tiling the swatch repeats, dashed)}

cmd:pattern.transform.desc: Transform only the pattern placement of the objects' pattern paints.

cmd:perspective.draw.desc: Draw a shape directly on a perspective plane.

cmd:perspective.grid.preset.params: {kind: 1|2|3} reset the grid to the one/two/three-point preset for the first artboard (and show it)

cmd:perspective.grid.set.params: {kind?: 1|2|3, origin?: [x,y], horizon?, vpLeft?, vpRight?, vpVertical?: [x,y], distance?, cell?, extent?, height?, visible?, plane?} merge into the document's grid

cmd:stroke.set.label: Stroke Options
cmd:stroke.set.params: {weight?: pt, cap?: butt|round|square, join?: miter|round|bevel, miterLimit?, align?: center|inside|outside, dash?: [d,g,…]|null (a 0 dash with a round or projecting cap draws dots or squares; a new pattern keeps the current offset and alignment), dashOffset? (exact dashes only), alignDashes?: bool (true: dashes fitted to corners and path ends, every run between them holding whole periods with a dash centred on each corner and end; false, the default for a new pattern: exact lengths), startArrow?, endArrow?: Arrow|ArrowOpen|Barbed|Concave|DoubleArrow|HalfArrowLeft|HalfArrowRight|Chevron|Feather|Swallowtail|Triangle|TriangleOpen|TriangleReverse|TriangleBar|Kite|Leaf|Drop|Circle|CircleOpen|HalfCircle|Oval|Target|Square|SquareOpen|Tag|TagOpen|Diamond|DiamondOpen|Hexagon|HexagonOpen|Star|Cross|Plus|Bar|DoubleBar|DotOnBar|Slash|DoubleSlash|Bracket|Fork|null (HalfArrowLeft/Right: one barb, left or right of the direction the head points), arrowAlign?: "extend" (tip past the end point, default)|"tip" (tip on the end point; the stroke is shortened), profile?: "uniform"|"lens"|"taperStart"|"taperEnd"|"pinch"|"teardrop"|"wave"|a saved profile's name (stroke.widthProfile.list), item?: stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item if it is a stroke, else the top stroke, created when missing), ids?} Without a stroke item, type takes weight, cap, join, miterLimit and the dash options as its characters' stroke (every run; text.setRangeStyle `strokeOptions` styles a range), and images and symbol instances (also in groups) are left alone. cmd:stroke.set.desc: Set stroke weight, caps, joins, alignment, dashes and arrowheads.

cmd:stroke.setAdvanced.label: Stroke Options
cmd:stroke.setAdvanced.params: {arrowScale?: [start %, end %], swapArrows?: bool, flipProfile?: "along"|"across", brush?: name|null, item?: stroke item index|null, ids?} Stroke panel extras (with nothing selected, all but brush set up the next object drawn)

cmd:stroke.widthPoint.copy.desc: Copy a stroke width point to another position along the path.

cmd:stroke.widthPoint.remove.label: Delete Width Point
cmd:stroke.widthPoint.remove.params: {id, index | indices: [..]} remove width points (removing the last one leaves a uniform stroke)
cmd:stroke.widthPoint.remove.desc: Delete width points from a variable-width stroke.

cmd:stroke.widthPoint.set.label: Width Point
cmd:stroke.widthPoint.set.params: {id, t: 0..1 (fraction of the path length), left, right: side widths in pt, index?: width point to edit or move, adjustAdjoining?: bool (with index: the nearest points either side change their widths in proportion)} → {index}. Creates a uniform profile first if needed
cmd:stroke.widthPoint.set.desc: Add or move a width point, setting both side widths.

cmd:stroke.widthProfile.add.desc: Save the selected stroke's variable width as a named profile.

cmd:stroke.widthProfile.delete.label: Delete Profile

cmd:stroke.widthProfile.delete.desc: Delete a saved width profile from the profile list.

cmd:stroke.widthProfile.list.label: Width Profiles

cmd:stroke.widthProfile.reset.label: Reset Profiles
cmd:stroke.widthProfile.reset.params: {} remove every saved profile, leaving the built-ins → {removed: count}
cmd:stroke.widthProfile.reset.desc: Remove every saved width profile, keeping the built-ins.

cmd:stroke.widthProfile.set.desc: Apply a variable width profile to the selected strokes.

cmd:swatch.addUsedColors.label: Add Used Colors

cmd:swatch.addUsedColors.desc: Add a swatch for each colour used in the artwork.

cmd:swatch.delete.label: Delete Swatch
cmd:swatch.delete.params: {name? | names?: [swatch or colour group names] (a group goes with its swatches), unlink?: true (art using a deleted global swatch keeps its colour, unlinked; false keeps the stale link)} delete in one undo step → {deleted, unlinked: paints unlinked}
cmd:swatch.delete.desc: Delete swatches or whole colour groups in one undo step.

cmd:swatch.edit.label: Swatch Options
cmd:swatch.edit.params: {name, newName?, color? (e.g. {l, a, b} for a Lab colour), mode?: "gray"|"rgb"|"hsb"|"lab"|"cmyk"|"web" (convert the colour), global?, spot? (spot colours are always global), paint?: paint.setFill params ({color}, {gradient}, {swatch} or {pattern}) replacing the swatch's colour, gradient or pattern with one of the same kind} edit a swatch in any colour group, as one undo step. Fills, strokes, text, gradient stops and tint swatches linked to a global swatch take its new colour (at their own tint) and name; turning Global off unlinks them (they keep their colour). Colour, mode and spot apply to solid colours only; a tint swatch only takes a new name (edit its base) → {name, relinked: paints changed}

cmd:swatch.editGroup.label: Edit Color Group
cmd:swatch.editGroup.params: {group: colour group, colors: [colour] (hex, key, {c,m,y,k} or {l,a,b}; the group's swatches take them in order, extra colours become new swatches, swatches past the end are removed; built-in swatches can't change), rename?: new group name} rewrite a colour group as one undo step; art linked to its global swatches takes their new colours (and keeps its colour, unlinked, when its swatch goes) → {name, swatches: [names], relinked}
cmd:swatch.editGroup.desc: Replace the swatches of a colour group, optionally renaming it.

cmd:swatch.library.add.label: Add to Swatches
cmd:swatch.library.add.params: {library: id or name, names?: [swatch or colour group names in the library] (default: all of it; a group comes as a colour group, a single swatch ungrouped), apply?: "fill"|"stroke" (also apply the first one to the selection and the defaults, as paint.setFill / paint.setStroke), focus?: true (with apply: false keeps the active proxy)} copy library swatches into the document as one undo step. cmd:swatch.library.get.label: Swatch Library
cmd:swatch.library.get.params: {library: id or name} → {id, name, category, swatches: [{name, kind, group, global, spot, color?, hex?, gradient?}] (as swatch.list), groups: [{name, swatches: [names]}]}

cmd:swatch.list.desc: List the document's swatches and colour groups with their colours.

cmd:swatch.spotOptions.params: {useLab?: bool (omitted: unchanged)} the document's Spot Colors options: spot colours defined in Lab show, print and export from their Lab values (true, the default: PDF Separation spaces get a Lab alternate) or from their working-CMYK equivalents (false: a DeviceCMYK alternate, matching older files). cmd:swatch.spotOptions.desc: Set whether spot colours separate from their lab values or cmyk equivalents.

cmd:swatch.ungroup.label: Ungroup Color Group
