cmd:swatch.unused.label: Select All Unused
cmd:swatch.unused.params: {} → {names: [the swatches nothing uses, in panel order]}: a colour is used when a paint links to it or an unlinked paint, gradient stop or mesh point has its colour; a gradient when a gradient links to it or has its stops; a pattern when it fills or strokes anything (art, symbols, pattern tiles and graphic styles count). None is never listed
cmd:swatch.unused.desc: Find the swatches nothing in the document uses.

cmd:symbol.adjust.label: Symbolism Tool
cmd:symbol.adjust.params: {tool: shift|scrunch|size|spin|stain|screen|style, points: [[x,y]…], radius?: 40, intensity?: 1..10 (5), alt?: bool, color?, style?: name} adjust instances near the points (selection, else all) → {count}
cmd:symbol.adjust.desc: Adjust symbol instances near the strokes of the symbolism tools.

cmd:symbol.breakLink.label: Break Link to Symbol
cmd:symbol.breakLink.params: {ids?} expand selected instances into plain art → {ids}
cmd:symbol.breakLink.desc: Break the link of symbol instances so they become plain editable art.

cmd:symbol.delete.label: Delete Symbol
cmd:symbol.delete.params: {name, expandInstances?: true} delete a symbol; its instances are expanded (or deleted with false)
cmd:symbol.delete.desc: Delete a symbol, expanding or deleting its instances.

cmd:symbol.duplicate.label: Duplicate Symbol
cmd:symbol.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a symbol under a new name.

cmd:symbol.edit.label: Edit Symbol
cmd:symbol.edit.params: {id?} break the link of the selected instance so its art can be edited; finish with symbol.update → {name, ids}
cmd:symbol.edit.desc: Break an instance's link so its art can be edited, then update the symbol.

cmd:symbol.list.label: Symbols
cmd:symbol.list.desc: List the document's symbols with instance counts and sizes.

cmd:symbol.new.label: New Symbol…
cmd:symbol.new.params: {name?, ids?} make a symbol from the selection and replace it with an instance → {name, id}
cmd:symbol.new.desc: Make a symbol from the selection, replacing it with an instance.

cmd:symbol.place.label: Place Symbol Instance
cmd:symbol.place.params: {name?, x?, y?} place an instance centred at (x, y) (default: artboard centre; name default: current) → {id}
cmd:symbol.place.desc: Place an instance of a symbol at a position.

cmd:symbol.replace.label: Replace Symbol
cmd:symbol.replace.params: {name, ids?} swap the symbol of the selected instances → {ids}
cmd:symbol.replace.desc: Swap the symbol of the selected instances to another symbol.

cmd:symbol.selectInstances.label: Select All Instances
cmd:symbol.selectInstances.params: {name} select every instance of a symbol → {count}
cmd:symbol.selectInstances.desc: Select every instance of a symbol in the document.

cmd:symbol.setCurrent.label: Current Symbol
cmd:symbol.setCurrent.params: {name} the symbol the symbolism tools spray (not an undo step)
cmd:symbol.setCurrent.desc: Choose the symbol the symbol sprayer sprays.

cmd:symbol.spray.label: Symbol Sprayer
cmd:symbol.spray.params: {points: [[x,y]…], name?, radius?: 40, density?: 1..10 (5), scale?: 1, alt?: bool (remove instances)} spray instances into a symbol set → {id, count}
cmd:symbol.spray.desc: Spray symbol instances onto the canvas with the symbol sprayer.

cmd:symbol.update.label: Redefine Symbol
cmd:symbol.update.params: {name, ids?} replace the symbol's art with the selection (instances update; the selection becomes an instance) → {name, id}
cmd:symbol.update.desc: Replace a symbol's art with the selection so all instances update.

cmd:text.areaOptions.label: Area Type Options…
cmd:text.areaOptions.params: {ids?, rows?, columns?, gutter?: pt, inset?: pt, firstBaseline?: ascent|capHeight|xHeight|leading|fixed, firstBaselineMin?: pt} set the selected area type's options (none given: query) → the first object's options
cmd:text.areaOptions.desc: Set area type options: rows, columns, gutter, inset and first baseline.

cmd:text.create.label: Create Text
cmd:text.create.params: {x, y, text, size?: pt, font?: family, style?, color?, area?: {width, height}} → {id}
cmd:text.create.desc: Create a text object with content, font, size and colour.

cmd:text.createInPath.label: Area / Path Type
cmd:text.createInPath.params: {path: id, mode: "area"|"onPath", text?: "", at?: [x, y] (on-path start: nearest point), size?, font?} turn a path into an area-type frame or a type-on-a-path baseline (the path's paint is dropped) → {id}
cmd:text.createInPath.desc: Turn a path into an area type frame or a type-on-a-path baseline.

cmd:text.editRange.label: Edit Text
cmd:text.editRange.params: {id, start: byte, end: byte, insert?: string, runs?: [{text, style}]} replace bytes start..end of the plain text (inserted text takes the replaced text's style unless styled `runs` are given) → {id, caret}
cmd:text.editRange.desc: Edit part of a text object's content by byte range.

cmd:text.fitHeadline.label: Fit Headline
cmd:text.fitHeadline.params: {ids?} track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width → {tracking}
cmd:text.fitHeadline.desc: Track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width.

cmd:text.fonts.label: Fonts in Document
cmd:text.fonts.params: {selectionOnly?} → [{family, style, runs, objects, missing}] sorted by name
cmd:text.fonts.desc: List the fonts used in the document, with missing ones flagged.

cmd:text.getRange.label: Get Text Range
cmd:text.getRange.desc: Read the text and style runs of a byte range.

cmd:text.replaceFont.label: Replace Font
cmd:text.replaceFont.params: {from: {family, style?}, to: {family, style?}, selectionOnly?} (style omitted: every style of the family / keep the closest style) → {runs}
cmd:text.replaceFont.desc: Replace one font with another across the document or selection.

cmd:text.setFormat.label: Character / Paragraph
cmd:text.setFormat.params: {ids?|id?, kerning?: 1/1000 em|"auto", baselineShift?: pt, hScale?: %, vScale?: %, rotation?: deg, underline?, strikethrough?, allCaps?, leftIndent?, rightIndent?, firstLineIndent?, spaceBefore?, spaceAfter?: pt, hyphenate?: bool}
cmd:text.setFormat.desc: Set character and paragraph formatting such as kerning, indents and caps.

cmd:text.setRangeStyle.label: Character
cmd:text.setRangeStyle.params: {id, start?: byte, end?: byte (default: all text), font?, style?, size?: pt, leading?: pt|"auto", tracking?, kerning?: 1/1000 em|"auto", baselineShift?: pt, hScale?: %, vScale?: %, rotation?: deg, fill?: colour|"none", stroke?: colour|"none", strokeWidth?: pt, strokeOptions?: {weight?, cap?, join?, miterLimit?, dash?, dashOffset?, alignDashes?} (as stroke.set: the character stroke), underline?, strikethrough?, allCaps?: bool, features?: ["dlig", "-liga", …]} style a character range (runs are split at the range ends) → {id, runs}
cmd:text.setRangeStyle.desc: Style a byte range of a text object: font, size, colour and more.

cmd:text.setStyle.label: Character
cmd:text.setStyle.params: {ids?|id?, font?, style?, size?: pt, leading?: pt|"auto", tracking?: 1/1000 em, justify?: "left"|"center"|"right"|"justifyAll", fill?: colour, features?: ["dlig", "-liga", …] OpenType}
cmd:text.setStyle.desc: Set character formatting for whole text objects: font, size, leading, colour and features.

cmd:text.setText.label: Set Text
cmd:text.setText.params: {id?|ids?, text} replace the contents of text objects (keeps the first run's style)
cmd:text.setText.desc: Replace the contents of text objects, keeping the first run's style.

cmd:text.tabs.clear.label: Clear All Tabs
cmd:text.tabs.clear.desc: Clear all tab stops of the selected text.

cmd:text.tabs.get.label: Tab Stops
cmd:text.tabs.get.params: {ids?} → {stops} of the first selected text object
cmd:text.tabs.get.desc: Read the tab stops of the first selected text object.

cmd:text.tabs.set.label: Set Tab Stops
cmd:text.tabs.set.params: {stops: [{position: pt, align?: left|center|right|decimal, leader?: ". ", alignOn?: "."}], ids?} replace the tab stops of the selected text
cmd:text.tabs.set.desc: Set the tab stops of the selected text with alignment and leaders.

cmd:text.thread.create.label: Create
cmd:text.thread.create.params: {} thread the selected area type (and closed paths, which become frames) in stacking order → {ids}
cmd:text.thread.create.desc: Thread the selected area type frames so text flows between them.

cmd:text.thread.info.label: Threads
cmd:text.thread.info.desc: List every text thread and the frames in order.

cmd:text.thread.releaseSelection.label: Release Selection
cmd:text.thread.releaseSelection.params: {} take the selected frames out of their threads (the story re-flows through the rest)
cmd:text.thread.releaseSelection.desc: Take the selected frames out of their text threads, reflowing the story.

cmd:text.thread.remove.label: Remove Threading
cmd:text.thread.remove.params: {} break the selected frames' threads; each frame keeps the text it shows
cmd:text.thread.remove.desc: Break the selected frames' threads, each keeping its text.

cmd:tool.options.label: Tool Options…
cmd:tool.options.params: {tool: id} what double-clicking a tool button opens: gradient → the Gradient panel (window.panel), eyedropper → Eyedropper Options (dialog `eyedropperOptions`, fields sampleSize, pickUp, apply; OK runs eyedropper.setOptions)
cmd:tool.options.desc: Open a tool's options, such as eyedropper options or the gradient panel.

cmd:tool.select.label: Select Tool
cmd:tool.select.desc: Make a tool the active tool.

cmd:tool.setOption.label: Tool Option
cmd:tool.setOption.desc: Set one tool option by key.

cmd:transparency.disableOpacityMask.label: Disable Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.disableOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?} keep the mask but stop applying it
cmd:transparency.disableOpacityMask.desc: Keep an opacity mask but stop applying it.

cmd:transparency.editOpacityMask.label: Edit Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.editOpacityMask.params: {id?} edit the mask art of `id` (default: the first selected object with a mask) in place, as clicking the mask thumbnail in the Transparency panel does → {layer}
cmd:transparency.editOpacityMask.desc: Edit an opacity mask's artwork in place on the canvas.

cmd:transparency.enableOpacityMask.label: Enable Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.enableOpacityMask.desc: Re-enable an opacity mask that was disabled.

cmd:transparency.info.label: Transparency Info
cmd:transparency.info.params: {id?|ids?} → {ids, opacity: 0..100, blend, isolate, knockout: "on"|"off"|"neutral", knockoutShape, editingMask, pageIsolatedBlending, pageKnockoutGroup} the Transparency panel's values for `ids`, the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited. A value is null where those objects differ (or there are none); editingMask is the id of the object whose mask is being edited, or null; the page values are the document's
cmd:transparency.info.desc: Report the transparency panel values of objects: opacity, blend, isolation and knockout.

cmd:transparency.linkOpacityMask.label: Link Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.linkOpacityMask.desc: Link an opacity mask to its object so they move together.

cmd:transparency.makeOpacityMask.label: Make Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.makeOpacityMask.params: {ids?, clip?, invert?} the topmost of the selected objects (or of `ids`) becomes the mask of the others (grouped if several). One object gets an empty mask and enters mask editing: draw the mask, then transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask → {id, editing}
cmd:transparency.makeOpacityMask.desc: Turn the topmost selected object into an opacity mask for the others.

cmd:transparency.opacityMaskInfo.label: Opacity Mask Info
cmd:transparency.opacityMaskInfo.params: {id?|ids?} → [{id, clip, invert, disabled, linked, art}] the opacity masks of `ids`, the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited
cmd:transparency.opacityMaskInfo.desc: Report the options and state of objects' opacity masks.

cmd:transparency.releaseOpacityMask.label: Release Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.releaseOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?} put the mask art back above each masked object (default: the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited, which leaves mask editing)
cmd:transparency.releaseOpacityMask.desc: Release an opacity mask, putting its artwork back on the canvas.

cmd:transparency.set.label: Transparency
cmd:transparency.set.params: {ids?|id?, opacity?: 0..100, blend?: name, isolate?, knockout?: "on"|"off"|"neutral"|bool (true = on, false = neutral), knockoutShape?: bool, item?: appearance item index|null} for `ids`, the selection, or the object whose opacity mask is being edited; opacity and blend go to the targeted fill/stroke item (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item, else the objects)
cmd:transparency.set.desc: Set opacity, blend mode, isolation or knockout for objects or an appearance item.

cmd:transparency.setOpacityMask.label: Opacity Mask Options
cmd:transparency.setOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?, clip?, invert?, disabled?, linked?} change the opacity masks of `ids`, the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited
cmd:transparency.setOpacityMask.desc: Change opacity mask options: clip, invert, disabled or linked.

cmd:transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask.label: Stop Editing Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask.desc: Leave opacity mask editing and return to normal editing.

cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksClipping.label: New Opacity Masks Are Clipping
cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksClipping.desc: Toggle whether new opacity masks are clipping masks by default.

cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksInverted.label: New Opacity Masks Are Inverted
cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksInverted.desc: Toggle whether new opacity masks are inverted by default.

cmd:transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlend.label: Page Isolated Blending
cmd:transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlend.params: {value?} make the page an isolated group (default: toggle): blend modes of top-level objects don't blend with what lies under the page; saved with the document and written to PDF → {value}
cmd:transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlend.desc: Toggle whether the page blends as an isolated group.

cmd:transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.label: Page Knockout Group
cmd:transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.params: {value?} make the page a knockout group (default: toggle): its layers (the contents of neutral layers) hide what they cover instead of showing it through their transparency; saved with the document and written to PDF → {value}
cmd:transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.desc: Toggle whether the page acts as a knockout group for its layers.

cmd:transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.label: Unlink Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?} the object moves without its mask
cmd:transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.desc: Unlink an opacity mask so the object moves without its mask.

cmd:transparency.viewOpacityMask.label: View Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.viewOpacityMask.params: {on?: bool (default: toggle), id?} show only the opacity mask of `id` (default: the object whose mask is edited, else the first selected object with a mask) on the canvas, as greyscale coverage, and edit it, as Alt-clicking the mask thumbnail does; off shows the artwork again (still editing) → {on, id}
cmd:transparency.viewOpacityMask.desc: Show and edit an object's opacity mask alone, as greyscale coverage.

cmd:type.changeCase.label: Change Case

cmd:type.convertToAreaType.params: {ids?} point type → area type framed by its current layout bounds → {ids}

cmd:type.fillPlaceholder.desc: Fill the selected text with placeholder text.

cmd:type.findFont.desc: Open the find font dialog to list and replace fonts.

cmd:type.fitHeadline.label: Fit Headline
cmd:type.fitHeadline.params: {ids?} track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width → {ids, tracking}
cmd:type.fitHeadline.desc: Track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width.

cmd:type.hiddenCharacters.label: Show Hidden Characters
cmd:type.hiddenCharacters.params: {} toggle markers for spaces, paragraph ends and story ends
cmd:type.hiddenCharacters.desc: Toggle markers for spaces, paragraph ends and story ends.

cmd:type.insert.label: Insert Character
cmd:type.insert.params: {char: "bullet"|"copyright"|"ellipsis"|"paragraph"|"registered"|"section"|"trademark"|"emDash"|"enDash"|"discretionaryHyphen"|"nonBreakingHyphen"|"doubleLeftQuote"|"doubleRightQuote"|"singleLeftQuote"|"singleRightQuote"|"emSpace"|"enSpace"|"hairSpace"|"sixthSpace"|"thinSpace"|"nonBreakingSpace"|"figureSpace"|"punctuationSpace"|"thirdSpace"|"quarterSpace"|"tab"|"forcedLineBreak"|"paragraphReturn" | text: string} append to the selected text objects
cmd:type.insert.desc: Insert a special character such as a bullet, dash, quote or space.

cmd:type.pathOptions.label: Type on a Path Options…

cmd:type.recentFont1.label: Recent Font 1

cmd:ui.colorGuideLimit.params: {library: swatch library id or name (see swatch.library.list) | "document" (the document's swatches) | "" or null (no limit)} limit the Color Guide panel's colours to that library: every harmony colour and variation snaps to its nearest colour, as color.harmony {limitTo} answers (ui.inspect: ui.color_guide_limit) → {limitTo, name}
